facts.fact: 阿拉里克守在塔拉辛床边，听见有人唤他才抬起头。
facts.anchor: Alaric looked up from where he was keeping vigil at Talasyn’s bedside.

facts.fact: 塞夫雷姆从口袋里取出东西，递到夜帝面前。
facts.anchor: he withdrew something from his pocket, holding it out to the Night Emperor

facts.fact: 阿拉里克看见自己的婚戒，眼睛睁大。
facts.anchor: Alaric’s eyes widened at the sight of his wedding band.

facts.fact: 他脱去护手，把婚戒套回无名指。
facts.anchor: slipped the wedding band onto his ring finger

facts.fact: 据医者说，她情况稳定，只是醒不过来。
facts.anchor: According to the healers, she was stable. She just wasn’t waking up.

facts.fact: 利苏刺她时的那阵恐惧又一次攫住他。
facts.anchor: the same wave of terror that had gripped him when Lisu stabbed her

facts.fact: 他承认没有她在身边，就无法带凯萨斯走出战争。
facts.anchor: I cannot lead Kesath out of war if you’re not by my side

facts.fact: 她的手指在他掌心动了动。
